"""RoboPaint episode record. Motions use only public poses, cameras and kinematics.
Every submitted trajectory is saved in commands/ in execution order.
Run with --replay only for an authorized fresh deployment, never this episode.
"""
import sys,json,pathlib,time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/app/output'); ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Q=np.array(json.loads((ROOT/'initial.json').read_text())['proprio']['now'][10:14])
r=Robot()
def obs(name='obs'):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=True)
    o.save('/app/runs/'+name)
    for c,im in o.last.items():Image.fromarray(im).save(str(ROOT/(name+'_'+c+'.png')))
    return o
def run(points,dt=.05,name='motion',cameras=['practice_cam','side_cam'],fps=10):
    p=np.asarray(points);p=np.c_[p,np.tile(Q,(len(p),1))] if p.shape[1]==3 else p
    d=ROOT/'commands';d.mkdir(exist_ok=True);n=len(list(d.glob('*.npz')))
    np.savez(d/f'{n:03d}_{name}.npz',points=p,dt=dt)
    a=r.submit('ee_pose',p,dt=dt,cameras=cameras,video='frames',video_fps=fps,note=name)
    a.save(f'/app/runs/{n:03d}_{name}')
    print(name,'now',a.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3], 'steps',a.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),'plan',a.meta.get('plan'),'left',a.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
    return a
def line(a,b,t):
    return np.linspace(a,b,max(2,round(t/.05)+1))[1:]
def move(p,t=1,name='move'):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=[]);start=o.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3]
    return run(line(start,p,t),name=name)
def replay():
    for f in sorted((ROOT/'commands').glob('*.npz')):
        a=np.load(f);r.submit('ee_pose',a['points'],dt=float(a['dt']),note=f.stem)
if __name__=='__main__' and '--replay' in sys.argv: replay()
